orderEdit.title: Edit sales order
orderEdit.intro: Revise a draft or rejected order. Saving a rejected order returns it to Draft and keeps its approval history.
orderEdit.blocked: Only manual Draft or Rejected orders without deliveries can be edited.
orderEdit.blockedPending: This order is pending approval and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedApproved: This order is approved and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedCancelled: This order is cancelled and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedConverted: This order was created from a quotation and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedDelivered: This order has a delivery or pending reserved quantity and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.conflict: The order changed. Your input is kept; refreshing will replace it with the latest saved version.
orderEdit.unavailable: This order may have been deleted or may be outside your edit scope. Refresh the saved order before deciding what to do next.
orderEdit.unknown: The update result is uncertain. Read the saved version before trying again.
orderEdit.noChange: No data changed. Nothing was sent.
orderEdit.rejected: The server rejected the order change. Check the reason below and correct the form before trying again.

orderCreate.unknownCreateOnly: The save result is uncertain. You cannot view orders; ask a colleague with order access to verify it before trying again.
orderCreate.serverUncertain: System error. The order may have been saved. Verify the result before taking another action.
orderCreate.taxRequired: Choose a valid output tax rate.
orderCreate.oneLineMinimum: An order needs at least one line.
orderCreate.lineLimit: You can add up to 1,000 lines.
orderCreate.title: Create sales order
orderCreate.intro: Save a manual draft or convert an approved quotation. The server assigns the number.
orderCreate.unknown: The save result is uncertain. Check saved orders before creating another.
orderCreate.rejected: The server rejected this order. Review the reason below and correct the form before trying again.
orderCreate.convertHint: Choose an approved quotation to create a linked order.
orderCreate.unsaved: Leave this page? Unsaved order entries will be lost.
orderCreate.customerInactive: Customer is inactive. Choose an active customer.
orderCreate.quotationUnavailable: Quotation is unavailable. Choose an approved quotation.
orderCreate.serverField: Review this field and try again.

order.title: Sales orders
order.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
order.invalidDates: Enter valid dates with From on or before To.
order.exportScope: Exports saved lines of the orders matching the applied filters, in the current language.
order.exportBusy: Export in progress. Wait for it to finish.
order.exportWaitLoad: Wait for the order list to finish loading.
order.exportNeedsList: Load the order list successfully before exporting.
order.exportNoRows: No orders match the applied filters, so there is nothing to export.
order.exportEmpty: No order lines within your export scope match the applied filters. No file was downloaded.
order.exportIncomplete: The export file was incomplete or its row count did not match. No file was downloaded; retry.
order.exportDenied: You do not have permission to export sales orders.
order.exportLimit: The export exceeds 10,000 order lines. Narrow the filters and try again.
order.exportInvalid: The export filters are invalid. Check the dates and status and try again.
order.exportFailed: The export failed. Retry; if it fails again, give the trace ID to support.
order.exportTimeout: The export timed out. No file was downloaded; check your connection and retry.
order.exportNoOrders: There are no orders yet, so there is nothing to export.

quotation.title: Sales quotations
quotation.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
quotation.invalidDates: Enter valid dates with From on or before To.

quotationCreate.name: Name
quotationCreate.conflict: The quotation or reference changed. Review your entries and retry.

validation.remark: Remark must be at most 500 characters.
validation.taxRateId: Enter a valid output tax rate ID.
validation.expiryDate: Enter a valid expiry date on or after the document date.
validation.currencyCode: Enter a three-letter uppercase currency code.
validation.quantity: Enter a positive quantity below 10^13 with up to 6 decimals.
validation.lines: Enter 1 to 1000 lines with unique numbers.
validation.unitPrice: Enter a nonnegative price below 10^13 with up to 6 decimals.
validation.lineNo: Line number must be positive and unique.
validation.serverField: Review the rejected field and try again.
validation.mixedCurrency: All quotation lines must use the same currency.

quotationCreate.rejected: The server rejected a referenced customer, item, currency or tax rate. Review the fields and retry.
quotationCreate.intro: Save a draft. The server assigns the number and calculates saved totals.
quotationCreate.title: Create sales quotation
quotationCreate.unsaved: Leave this page? Unsaved quotation entries will be lost.
quotationCreate.outcomeUnknown: Save result is unknown. Check the quotation list before creating another draft.

quotationEdit.conflict: This quotation changed. Your entries are still here. Refresh to load the latest saved version; this will replace your entries.
quotationEdit.title: Edit sales quotation
quotationEdit.intro: Revise a saved Draft or Rejected quotation. Saving a Rejected quotation returns it to Draft and keeps approval history.
quotationEdit.blocked: Only Draft and Rejected quotations can be edited.
quotationEdit.outcomeUnknown: Update result is unknown. Check the saved quotation before trying again.

delivery.title: Sales outbound
delivery.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
delivery.invalidDates: Enter valid dates with From on or before To.
delivery.stateDraft: Draft: no order balance is reserved and no stock has changed.
delivery.statePending: Pending approval: these quantities reserve the order balance. Stock changes only when the final approval posts the delivery.
delivery.stateRejected: Rejected: no order balance is reserved and no stock has changed. Revise and resubmit, or delete the draft.
delivery.statePosted: Posted: stock was issued through inventory with the movement IDs below. A posted delivery cannot be edited or deleted; correct it with a sales return.

deliveryCreate.title: New sales outbound
deliveryCreate.intro: Saving creates a Draft: it does not reserve order balance and does not reduce stock. Submitting reserves the balance; stock is issued only when final approval posts it.
deliveryCreate.needOrderView: You need the "View sales orders" permission to choose a source order. Contact your administrator.
deliveryCreate.orderNotApproved: This order is no longer Approved, so no outbound can be created for it. Choose another order.
deliveryCreate.noBalance: Every line of this order is fully used by posted or pending outbounds, so there is nothing left to ship.
deliveryCreate.balanceHint: These balances were read when the order loaded. Other outbounds submitted or posted meanwhile change them; the server rechecks on save and on submit.
deliveryCreate.locationNeedsWarehouse: Choose a warehouse before choosing a location.
deliveryCreate.needWarehouseView: You need the "View warehouses" permission to choose warehouses and locations. Contact your administrator.
deliveryCreate.oneLineMinimum: An outbound needs at least one line.
deliveryCreate.saved: Outbound draft {{number}} saved. Stock has not changed.
deliveryCreate.unknown: We could not confirm whether the draft was saved (timeout, network or server error). Search the outbound list first and create it again only if no new draft is there, to avoid duplicates.
deliveryCreate.unknownCreateOnly: We could not confirm whether the draft was saved (timeout, network or server error). You cannot view outbounds, so ask a colleague who can to check before creating it again.
deliveryCreate.serverUncertain: The server reported an error; we could not confirm whether the draft was saved.
deliveryCreate.lineRejected: The server refused the highlighted line and nothing was saved. Correct that line and save again.
deliveryCreate.rejected: The server refused to save; nothing changed.
deliveryCreate.unsaved: This outbound has not been saved. Leave anyway?

validation.decimal: Enter a quantity above 0 with up to 13 integer and 6 decimal digits.
validation.aboveRemaining: The lines for this order line add up to more than its available balance.
